author: Ryan Clark
title: Stephanie McMahon Asks AJ Styles To His Face - 'Why Didn't You Put Your Gloves Down?' - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
1 hours ago
Fresh off his retirement match, AJ Styles is set to appear on Stephanie McMahon’s podcast tomorrow (Thursday) morning. McMahon revealed on Twitter Wednesday night that Styles will be this week’s guest on her “What’s Your Story?” podcast.
Along with the announcement, McMahon posted a teaser clip from the episode. In the preview, she asks Styles about the moment following his career-ending loss to GUNTHER, when he hinted at removing his gloves but ultimately decided against it. Styles doesn’t reveal the reason in the clip, keeping the full explanation saved for the episode — as any good teaser should.
McMahon wrote,
“Honored to have as my next guest…The Phenomenal, @AJStylesOrg!
READ MORE: Nikki Bella – ‘The WWE Women’s Division Is Better Than The Men’s Division’
READ MORE: Tony Khan – ‘Developing Steven Borden Is A Huge Priority For AEW’
An all new #whatsyourstory drops tomorrow morning wherever you get your pods.
@WWE @Fanatics @EGxo”
It has been noted by people like Peter Rosenberg that Styles has told them the loss at the 2026 Royal Rumble was legitimately the end of his in-ring career. That has not stopped speculation or reports of outside interest in Styles, including from the likes of AEW or NJPW.
